SENIOR EMBEDDED FIRMWARE ENGINEER 
 Role Overview: 
 We are expanding our team with engineers specializing in modern micro-controller-based systems and real-time software. The role focuses on firmware development , board support packages, device drivers, connectivity stacks, and RTOS-based applications using Zephyr and FreeRTOS .
 You will contribute to next-generation connected products where reliability, low power consumption, and real-time behavior are critical.
 Your role: 
Design and develop embedded firmware for MCU-based systems.
Develop BSPs and low-level drivers.
Work with Zephyr RTOS and FreeRTOS. 
Integrate wireless communication technologies.
Develop middleware and application services.
Support hardware bring-up and debugging activities.
Perform memory and power optimization.
Participate in system architecture and design reviews.
Contribute to CI/CD and automated testing environments.
 Your profile: 
 Must Have: 
Strong C programming
Embedded C++
Real-Time Operating Systems
Zephyr RTOS
FreeRTOS
ARM Cortex-M architecture
Debugging using JTAG/SWD
Embedded communication protocols
 Communication Technologies: 
SPI
I2C
UART
CAN
Ethernet
 Desired Experience: 
5+ years in Embedded Software Development
Experience with STM32, NXP, Renesas, Nordic, or TI platforms
Development of connected IoT or industrial devices
Experience from concept to production release
